query: How do I document and report cases of caste prejudice?
reference_answer:
Reporting Casteist Discrimination:
Report casteist discrimination to the nearest police station or the District Social Welfare Officer. You can also contact the Tamil Nadu State Commission for SC/ST (Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes) for assistance.
answer: To document and report cases of caste prejudice, follow these steps: Gather details about the incident, note the date and location, and collect witness statements. Report to relevant authorities such reliefs or local government bodies. Document all communications and evidence for future reference. [Document N]
